title: Birds of Rhode Island: Seasonal Distribution and Ecological History
content: Birds of Rhode Island: Seasonal Distribution and Ecological History by FerrenRichard L., edited by Veit,Richard R.illustrated by Margaret La Farge. 2024. Cornell University Press, Ithaca, New York. pp., 28 color photos, 10 original figures. $59.95 (hardcover). ISBN 9781501771330.
